note: Candy Share (teen numbers minus ones, no borrow). English only. Teaching has no dangling question; the 1 s pauses are beats before the next action. Type A (take) = a*_a names the total, then tells how many candies to drag to the plate; the how_many line is played only after the drag action is finished. Type B (group) = b*_q, pick the group that shows the total. Type C (wrong) = find_wrong is shared by the three sentences, exactly one of which is false.

lines.text: Look at the candies. One full box of ten, and eight outside. That's eighteen.
Let's take away five candies from the ones.
So, eighteen minus five equals thirteen!
When we take away, the box of ten stays the same.
We only take away the ones.
There are seventeen candies. Take away four candies from the ones.
There are eighteen candies. Take away five candies from the ones.
There are sixteen candies. Take away two candies from the ones.
There are nineteen candies. Take away four candies from the ones.
Find the group that shows sixteen.
Find the group that shows eighteen.
Find the group that shows fourteen.
